# ankra_morpheus_networks (Data Source)

The HPE Morpheus networks behind a credential, for `network_id` on `ankra_morpheus_cluster`. The counterpart of `ankra cluster morpheus networks`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_morpheus_networks" "all" {
  credential_id = ankra_morpheus_credential.main.id
}

output "morpheus_networks" {
  value = { for network in data.ankra_morpheus_networks.all.networks : network.name => network.id }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credential_id` (String) Credential to read the catalogue through.

### Read-Only

- `networks` (Attributes List) Networks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--networks))

<a id="nestedatt--networks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `networks`

Read-Only:

- `cidr` (String) CIDR, when reported.
- `cloud_id` (Number) Id of the cloud the network belongs to, when reported.
- `id` (Number) Network id.
- `name` (String) Network name.
